title: Passenger Door Structure — Bolted Repair of a Cracked Hinge Arm Rib Web

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Passenger and Crew Doors — Door Structure

abstract: Bolted repair of a cracked hinge arm rib web in a passenger door, used where the crack has started at the lightening hole and has not reached the spar cap.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the load path across a cracked hinge arm rib web in a passenger door structure by installing a bolted web plate, and returns the door to its full opening cycle capability.
sections.damage_assessment: Remove the door interior lining and clean the rib web. Establish both crack tips by dye penetrant and record the crack length and its position relative to the lightening hole. A crack that has reached the spar cap D5210111928628, a crack that has crossed a second lightening hole, or a crack accompanied by fretting at the hinge arm bearing is outside the scope of this repair and requires the door to be removed for assessment. Check the hinge arm bearing for play in two axes before you decide; play beyond the limit means the crack is a symptom and the repair will not last. Record the door opening cycles if the operator maintains a count.
sections.repair_procedure: Drill the crack stop holes at both tips to the diameter on repair drawing RD-52-10-11-912 and ream them to the finish given. Do a dye penetrant inspection of both holes and confirm that the tips have been captured. Machine the web plate seat and prepare the faying surfaces. Apply the chromate-free protection to all bare material. Fit the web plate YS601888-67 dry and check the fit over the whole footprint with a feeler gauge, shimming any gap larger than the drawing value. Install the anchor nuts EN395524K9 in the web to the pattern on sheet 2 and install the titanium bolts AGS119203K9 at the four positions that carry the hinge load. Install the remaining fasteners wet with sealant, working outwards from the crack stop holes, and torque them in the sequence on sheet 3. Where the plate reaches the door clip D5210114722293, use the shorter fastener given on the drawing. Seal the plate edge, restore the protection scheme and refit the door interior lining.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do a detailed visual inspection of the plate perimeter and both crack stop holes every 4000 flight cycles or every 3000 door opening cycles, whichever occurs first. Check the hinge arm bearing play at the same interval. Any growth from a crack stop hole, any loose fastener, or bearing play beyond the limit makes the repair invalid and the door must be removed. The repair is life limited to 15000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: A single crack up to 45 millimetres from the lightening hole edge, not reaching the spar cap, not crossing a second lightening hole and with hinge arm bearing play inside the published limit.

repair_drawings.title: Bolted web plate, passenger door hinge arm rib

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two rows around the plate perimeter, 28 fasteners, 20 mm pitch, 14 mm edge distance, with four titanium bolts at the hinge load positions
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Repair is life limited to 15000 flight cycles; a repeat detailed visual inspection is required every 4000 flight cycles or 3000 door opening cycles.
